title: quartz source
description: Produces a message, without a body, at every time a Quartz cron expression matches, with header quartz.firetime. A time missed while the flow is busy or paused is skipped.

path.title: Name
path.description: Name of the schedule, from the URI (quartz:<name>); informational only

cron.title: Cron
cron.description: Quartz cron expression: seconds minutes hours day-of-month month day-of-week [year], e.g. 0 0 3 * * ? for 03:00 every day. Supports *, ?, values, ranges, steps, lists and names (JAN, MON); not L, W or #

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the expression, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam; empty for the local time zone
